source_arguments.statement:
theorem physicalIncomingQuotient_residue (q : XiZeroCopy) (branch side : Bool) (a : ℂ)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : b ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) :
    Tendsto (fun u => (u-physicalFundamentalFrequency q side)*
      (continuedResponse (physicalRate q branch) (physicalRadialFrequency q) a 1
        (reducedGreenGradient (physicalRadialFrequency q) (physicalRate q branch) 1) b u/
          horizon u (physicalRadialFrequency q) b))
      (𝓝[≠] physicalFundamentalFrequency q side) (𝓝 (physicalIncomingPoleAmplitude q branch side a))
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem physicalIncomingQuotient_residue (q : XiZeroCopy) (branch side : Bool) (a : ℂ)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : b ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) :
    Tendsto (fun u => (u-physicalFundamentalFrequency q side)*
      (continuedResponse (physicalRate q branch) (physicalRadialFrequency q) a 1
        (reducedGreenGradient (physicalRadialFrequency q) (physicalRate q branch) 1) b u/
          horizon u (physicalRadialFrequency q) b))
      (𝓝[≠] physicalFundamentalFrequency q side) (𝓝 (physicalIncomingPoleAmplitude q branch side a))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let w := physicalFundamentalFrequency q side
  let s := physicalRate q branch
  let chi := physicalRadialFrequency q
  let K := reducedGreenGradient chi s 1
  have hw := physicalFundamentalFrequency_strip q side
  have hwr := (abs_lt.mp hw.2).1
  have hs := physicalFundamentalFrequency_sub_sourceRate_ne_zero q branch side
  have hf : w=-3/2-Complex.I*chi ∨ w=-3/2+Complex.I*chi := by
    dsimp only [w,chi]
    rw [physicalFundamentalFrequency_connection_root]
    cases side <;> simp
  have hh : horizon w chi b ≠ 0 := by
    rw [horizon_eq_normalizable_fundamental w chi hw.1 hf hb,
      normalizable_fundamental_value w chi hf]
    exact mul_ne_zero (power_ne_zero _ hb.1) (power_ne_zero _ (sub_pos.mpr hb.2))
  let N := fun u : ℂ =>
    ((normalizable u chi b/horizon u chi b)*firstEndpointMellin (horizonMellinCore s chi a 1 K) b u+
      ∫ z in Ioc b (1:ℝ), normalizable u chi z*sourceProfile s u a 1 K 1 z)*
        (1/(u-2*s)+onsetCorrection (2*s) u)
  have hH := horizon_frequency_analyticAt w chi hw.1 hb
  have hS : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => 1/(u-2*s)+onsetCorrection (2*s) u) w :=
    (analyticAt_const.div (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const) hs).add
      ((onsetCorrection_entire (2*s)).analyticAt w)
  have hN : AnalyticAt ℂ N w :=
    (((((normalizable_frequency_entire chi hb).analyticAt w).div hH hh).mul
      (horizonFirstMellin_analyticAt s chi a 1 K w hw.1 hwr hb.1 hb.2)).add
      ((outerSourceIntegral_entire s chi a 1 K hb.1 hb.2).analyticAt w)).mul hS
  have hD : HasDerivAt (fun u => -connection u chi) (-connectionSimpleSlope w chi side) w :=
    (physicalFundamental_connection_hasDerivAt q side).neg
  have hd : -connectionSimpleSlope w chi side ≠ 0 :=
    neg_ne_zero.mpr (physicalFundamental_connectionSlope_ne_zero q side)
  have hz : -connection w chi=0 := by
    simp only [w,chi,physicalFundamentalFrequency_connection_zero,neg_zero]
  have hlim := (hN.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).div hD.tendsto_slope hd
  have hvalue : N w/(-connectionSimpleSlope w chi side)=physicalIncomingPoleAmplitude q branch side a := by
    have hn : normalizable w chi b ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← horizon_eq_normalizable_fundamental w chi hw.1 hf hb]
      exact hh
    dsimp only [N,physicalIncomingPoleAmplitude]
    rw [horizon_eq_normalizable_fundamental w chi hw.1 hf hb,div_self hn,one_mul,
      fundamental_source_sum_eq_moment w chi s a hw.1 hwr hf hb]
  rw [hvalue] at hlim
  apply hlim.congr'
  have hhg : ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝[≠] w, horizon u chi b ≠ 0 :=
    (hH.continuousAt.eventually_ne hh).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  filter_upwards [hhg,hD.eventually_ne (c := 0) hd] with u hhu hcu
  have hc : connection u chi ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mp hcu
  simp only [Pi.div_apply,slope_def_field,hz,sub_zero,div_div_eq_mul_div]
  change N u*(u-w)/(-connection u chi)=
    (u-w)*(continuedResponse s chi a 1 K b u/horizon u chi b)
  dsimp only [N,continuedResponse,continuedHorizonMoment,continuedOuterMoment]
  field_simp [hhu,hc]
  ring

/-- Regular Schur complementation is one instance of the rational assembly grammar. -/
theorem SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly.schur
    {A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ C₀ C₁ D₀ D₁ D₀inv D₁inv : GammaOp}
    (hA : SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly A₀ A₁)
    (hB : SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly B₀ B₁)
    (hC : SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly C₀ C₁)
    (hD : SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly D₀ D₁)
    (hD₀left : D₀inv ∘L D₀ = 1) (hD₀right : D₀ ∘L D₀inv = 1)
    (hD₁left : D₁inv ∘L D₁ = 1) (hD₁right : D₁ ∘L D₁inv = 1) :
    SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly
      (A₀ - (B₀ ∘L D₀inv) ∘L C₀)
      (A₁ - (B₁ ∘L D₁inv) ∘L C₁) :=
  hA.sub ((hB.comp (hD.inverse hD₀left hD₀right hD₁left hD₁right)).comp hC)

/-- Every ordinary logarithmic singular residue is invariant under a regular rational assembly of
the actual causal-depth Gamma feature. -/
theorem hasSchattenLogResidue_one_suzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly_iff
    {A₀ A₁ : GammaOp}
    (h : SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly A₀ A₁)
    (hA₀cpt : IsCompactOperator A₀) (R : ℝ) :
    HasSchattenLogResidue 1 A₁ R ↔ HasSchattenLogResidue 1 A₀ R := by
  have hdiff :=
    suzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly_sub_memSchattenClass_one h
  have hdiffcpt : IsCompactOperator (A₁ - A₀) := hdiff.isCompactOperator one_pos
  have hA₁cpt : IsCompactOperator A₁ := by
    have hid : A₁ = A₀ + (A₁ - A₀) := by abel
    rw [hid]
    exact hA₀cpt.add hdiffcpt
  exact hasSchattenLogResidue_one_iff_of_traceClass_sub
    hA₁cpt hA₀cpt hdiff R

/-- A coefficient-faithful regular rational reporter would have to assign different measurable
logarithmic residues to source-free and source-present circuit outputs. -/
structure SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalResidueCoefficientFaithful where
  background : GammaOp
  source : GammaOp
  assembly : SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly background source
  background_compact : IsCompactOperator background
  backgroundResidue : ℝ
  sourceResidue : ℝ
  background_residue : HasSchattenLogResidue 1 background backgroundResidue
  source_residue : HasSchattenLogResidue 1 source sourceResidue
  detects_actual_source : sourceResidue ≠ backgroundResidue

/-- **Regular-rational singular-residue CCM--FU no-go.** No finite bounded rational circuit,
including arbitrary products, adjoints, bounded resolvents, and Schur complements, can turn the
actual nuclear Gamma feature into a changed ordinary logarithmic singular residue. -/
theorem no_suzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalResidueCoefficientFaithful :
    ¬ Nonempty SuzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalResidueCoefficientFaithful := by
  rintro ⟨P⟩
  have hsourceOnBackground : HasSchattenLogResidue 1 P.background P.sourceResidue :=
    (hasSchattenLogResidue_one_suzukiCausalDepthGammaRegularRationalAssembly_iff
      P.assembly P.background_compact P.sourceResidue).1 P.source_residue
  have heq : P.sourceResidue = P.backgroundResidue :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique hsourceOnBackground P.background_residue
  exact P.detects_actual_source heq

end
